intro: Innkeeper Allison manages the Gilded Rose, one of the busiest and most central inns in Stormwind City. Located in the heart of the Trade District right between the bank and auction house, she provides weary travelers and local merchants with hearthstone bindings, refreshing drinks, and shelter.

p: Positioned squarely between the bustling trade auction house and the main city vaults, the Gilded Rose serves as an epicenter for adventurers arriving in Stormwind. Innkeeper Allison stands behind the main counter on the ground floor, keeping order amidst a constant flow of peddlers, mercenaries, and visiting diplomats. Beyond offering lodging and hearthstone services, she frequently participates in local holiday festivities and coordinates small errands for traveling heroes seeking rest within the capital.
